name: Steam separators / dryers and steam headers (moisture carryover limits)
description: Remove entrained water droplets from steam that traps cannot catch; protect turbines, control valves and heat-transfer equipment from erosion, water hammer and reduced heat transfer; provide dry steam at point of use (TLV; Spirax Sarco). Primary source: https://www.tlv.com/steam-info/steam-theory/other/separators

specifications.basis: TLV: at flow velocities as low as 10 m/s, directional changes and pressure differentials can entrain bottom condensate
vendor claim using all four separation principles (mechanical impediment, velocity, directional change, impingement)
TLV basics; boilers do not generate 100% dry saturated steam without superheater

specifications.metric: sodium in steam indicating mechanical carryover
specifications.basis: Chemical Engineering steam purity limit; saturated-steam sampling used to check drum mechanical carryover / failed separators
Spirax Sarco: possible with superheated steam if pressure drop acceptable, allowing smaller distribution pipelines
